Coram Hon'Ble Mr. Justice Rajesh Shankar

-----
 For the Petitioner: Mr. Tarun Kumar No.1
 For the State: Mr. Sardhu Mahto, A.P.P
 -----
03/14.08.2024 Heard learned counsel for the parties.

2. The petitioner apprehending his arrest in connection with the case registered under Sections
406/420/120B/506 Ipc has prayed for grant of anticipatory bail.
3.  Learned counsel for the petitioner submits that the petitioner has been falsely implicated in this case and has not committed any offence as alleged in the complaint.

As per the allegation, the petitioner and the other co-accused persons though received Rs.5,09,000/- from the complainant/the O.P.No.2 out of the total consideration amount of Rs.9,60,000/- for sale of 20 Decimals of land, however, they refused to execute the sale deed in that regard.
It is further submitted that the complainant has already filed a civil suit being Original Suit No. 276/2021 in the concerned Civil Court for specific performance of contract.

Similarly situated other co-accused,
namely, Bharti Devi, Sushil Kumar Sinha, Arun Kumar Sinha, Jitendra Kumar Sinha and Prafull Kumar Sinha have already been granted anticipatory bail by a coordinate Bench of this Court vide order dated 16.05.2024 passed in A.B.A. No. 2360/2024.
The petitioner also undertakes to co-operate in the ongoing investigation.
Hence, he may be given the privilege of anticipatory bail.
4. Learned A.P.P opposes the petitioner's prayer for anticipatory bail.
5. Considering the aforesaid facts and circumstances of the case, I am inclined to enlarge the petitioner on anticipatory bail.

Accordingly, the above named petitioner is directed to surrender Deepak Kumar Sinha vs The State Of Jharkhand on 14 August, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/150543792/
1 before the concerned Court below within a period of three weeks.

If he surrenders before the Court below within the aforesaid period, he shall be released on bail on furnishing bail-bond of Rs.20,000/- (twenty thousand only) with two sureties of the like amount each to the satisfaction of the Judicial Magistrate, 1st Class, Dhanbad in connection with Complaint Case No. 2303/2021,
subject to the conditions as laid down under Section 482(2) of the Bharatiya Nagarik Suraksha Sanhita, 2023.

Satish/- (RAJESH SHANKAR, J)
